args.title: Use production URL instead of localhost fallback in password reset email
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use the configured application URL from `config` or the appropriate environment variable (such as `config.publicUrl` or similar app config) instead of falling back to `http://localhost:3000` via `process.env.PUBLIC_URL`, or ensure `PUBLIC_URL` is configured correctly in production so password reset links point to the correct domain.
